name: compact-page-action
goal: Page cards open through a compact icon with an accessible label, tooltip and unchanged navigation.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Page cards currently use a full-width text link. Keep a single compact icon, an accessible Open page label, a hover tooltip and the same destination at each viewport.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: The unchanged local desktop regression fails: the full-width Open page arrow link has no concise accessible name or hover title. The same checkpoint screenshot was saved before asserting.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reused WorkspaceLink and Icon for a 36px page action; added hover title support and readable contracts for the three edited components. Planned review links retain text.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: All 18 renderer browser checks pass, including unchanged compact-action assertions in local and hosted modes at desktop, tablet and mobile sizes; Enter opens the same page.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
